items.titleZh: F1车手准备迎接巴库站“极其不自然”的驾驶挑战
items.summaryZh: F1车手预计巴库站将暴露2026年赛车需要更多“极其不自然”驾驶方式的问题，车手对能量部署缺乏控制，并担忧排位赛和正赛中的极端速度差可能带来危险。
items.originalTitle: F1车手准备迎接巴库站“极其不自然”的驾驶挑战
items.summaryEn: F1 drivers expect Baku to expose the need for more "super unnatural" driving of the 2026 cars, with drivers having no control over energy deployment and fearing dangerous closing speeds in qualifying and the race.
detailZh: F1车手准备迎接巴库站在本周末阿塞拜疆大奖赛期间暴露2026年赛车需要更多“极其不自然”驾驶方式的问题。
巴库提供了独特的挑战，因为它拥有赛历上最长的全油门路段（超过两公里长），但这给F1能量匮乏的2026年赛车带来了重大问题。
这意味着车手在排位赛中需要在起终点直道上部署大部分电池能量，导致他们在赛道其余部分动力极低，弯道出弯时出现巨大的功率差异。
“这会很有趣，因为你有两三条独特的直道需要部署大量动力，然后你在中间路段大部分时间都以非常非常低的功率运行，因为在那些超短直道上部署任何能量都非常低效，”哈斯车手奥利·贝尔曼解释道。
“你倾向于把能量留给通往1号弯、3号弯的较长直道。这意味着动力输出存在巨大差异。你出2号弯驶向3号弯时，有1000马力或无论多少，最大马力，然后出3号弯时只有大约三分之二，因为那是一条很短的直道，所以突然你的油门踏板只有前一个弯道一半的动力。
“所以这是非常奇怪的事情。它发生在某些赛道上，尤其是能量匮乏的赛道，但只在有短直道的特定区域。
“我们在蒙扎第二个减速弯（通往莱斯莫弯）之后遇到过，而在这里，每条短直道之间你都有非常低的功率。
“这意味着这真的很奇怪，因为你可以想象你在中间路段做一件事，然后突然你出另一个弯，动力翻倍。
“这对我们来说极其不自然；在今年二月之前，我们从未有过这种情况。”
车手对此无法控制，正如贝尔曼所说，“你只是踩油门踏板、刹车和转向，一切都会自行处理。我们在驾驶时实际上做的任何事情都不一定能影响它”。
车手以尽可能接近100%的电量到达起终点直道将至关重要——否则在排位赛和正赛中都将付出高昂代价。
正如皮埃尔·加斯利所解释的，“如果你没有100%，你只会更早开始削功率，但在这里更早不是200米，当你以低几公里/小时的速度持续那么长时间时，就开始变得相当昂贵了。
“从比赛角度来看，这种直道上有时你看到的不仅仅是一辆车经过，所以我绝对建议处于车群前列，尤其是在比赛日。
“但现实是我们无法控制所有这些方面。这是软件、各种因素、事故、条件等等，有时让我们处于有利或不利的一面，所以我们必须看看，但可以肯定的是，保持良好状态很重要。”
起终点线距1号弯不到200米，这意味着准备圈的车手在16号左弯出弯后的大部分路段将仅依靠内燃机动力。
从16号左弯出弯开始有1250米的时段，车手可以避免功率下降率并减少350千瓦功率，这意味着他们将仅靠内燃机动力行驶。还有类似的时段，如果他们愿意，可以从3号弯一直到12号弯纯靠内燃机动力行驶。
相比之下，正在飞驰圈的车手一旦进入主直道就会部署大部分能量，因此正如车手们已经警告的那样，可能会出现一些极端的接近速度。
“开始圈的车手非常慢，直到电池在起终点线前介入，”费尔南多·阿隆索说。
“大约有20秒你会以200公里/小时行驶，而其他人以350公里/小时冲过来。
“无法移动，尤其是在18-19号弯（全油门弯道）。所以这将是本周末的挑战之一：确保我们安全，在车手简报会上，我们选择移动的位置。”
奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托预测，“这会有点混乱，尤其是我们在飞驰圈离开最后一个弯时速度那么快，而开始圈的车手会那么慢。
“所以希望这不会危险。希望我们在18号和19号弯能做些事情，因为我想如果你以我不知道300公里/小时左右的速度冲过来，而另一辆车以250公里/小时行驶，因为没有MGU-K在部署，那可能会很危险。”
当被问及是否会在周四的车手简报会上讨论时，博尔托莱托说：“是的，但他们打算怎么做呢？”
巴库的主要挑战之一是环绕赛道的建筑物之间流动的风，它每一圈、每个弯道都在变化。周五排位赛还预报有39公里/小时的大风。
弗兰科·科拉平托说：“我认为风会很棘手；去年我们因为风看到了很多红旗。它变化得像疯了一样——阵风，因为建筑物。
“你会遇到五秒钟的阵风，然后五秒钟没有，然后又来。它太不稳定了，对我们来说非常困难，尤其是在街道赛道上。
“这让比赛更加棘手，更加危险。”
赛车公牛车手阿尔维德·林德布拉德不太确定：“我认为在今年赛车上这不是大问题，因为它们对空气动力学不那么敏感”。不过我相信这仍然是个问题。
detailEn: Formula 1 drivers are braced for Baku to expose the requirement for more "super unnatural" driving of the 2026 cars during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix this weekend.
Baku provides a unique challenge as it possesses the longest flat-out run on the calendar (over two kilometres long), but that creates major problems for F1's energy-starved 2026 cars.

It means drivers will need to deploy most of their battery on the start/finish straight in qualifying, leaving them with very little power around the rest of the lap and some huge power disparities on corner exits.

"‘It's going to be interesting because you have two or three distinctive straights where you have to deploy a lot of power and then you spend a lot of the middle sector running with really, really low power because it's very inefficient to deploy any energy in those super short straights," Haas driver Ollie Bearman explained.

"You tend to save it for the longer ones into Turn 1, into Turn 3. It means that you have a massive disparity in power delivery. You come out of Turn 2 heading into Turn 3 and you have a thousand horsepower or however much, maximum horsepower and then you have like two-thirds of that coming out of Turn 3 because it's a really short straight, so suddenly your throttle pedal is half as powerful as it was in the previous corner.
"So it's a really strange thing. It happens in some circuits, especially the energy-starved ones, but it's only in specific areas where there's short straights.
"We had it in Monza out of the second chicane [towards the Lesmos], here between every short straight you have really low power.
"It means that it's really strange because you can imagine you spend the middle sector doing one thing and then suddenly you come out of another corner and you have twice as much power.
"It's super unnatural for us; we've never had that before ever until February this year."

Drivers have no control over this, as Bearman says, "you just press the throttle pedal and brake and steer, and it all takes care of itself. There's nothing we actually do whilst driving that can necessarily affect it".
It's going to be crucial for drivers to arrive at the start/finish straight with as close to 100% battery as possible - or it will be very costly in both qualifying and the race.

As Pierre Gasly explained, "if you don't have 100%, "You're just going to start clipping earlier, but earlier here is not 200 metres [and] when you're down a couple of km/h for that long, then it starts to be quite costly.
"Racing-wise, it's the type of straight where sometimes you don't only see one car passing by, so I would definitely recommend to be top of the pack, especially when it comes to race day.

"But the reality is we don't have control of all of that side. It's software, it's whatever, incidents, conditions, etc that sometimes leads us to being on the right side of it or the wrong side of it, so we'll have to see, but for sure, it's important to be fine."

The start/finish line being located less than 200 metres from Turn 1 means drivers on a preparation lap will be relying solely on internal combustion engine power for the majority of the run out of the Turn 16 left-hander.

There's a 1250 metre period beginning at the exit of the Turn 16 left-hander where drivers can avoid a ramp-down rate and drop 350kw of power, meaning they'll just be on internal combustion engine power. And a similar period where they can do the same and run purely on ICE power from Turn 3 all the way to Turn 12 if they wish to do so.
In contrast, those drivers on a lap will be deploying most of their energy once on the main straight, so there's the potential for some extreme closing speeds as drivers have already warned.
"People opening the lap are very slow until the battery comes in just before the line," Fernando Alonso said.
"There are like 20 seconds that you will be at 200km/h, and people are coming at 350[km/h].

"There is no way to move, especially in Turn 18-19 [flat-out kinked corners]. So that will be one of the challenges of the weekend: to make sure that we are safe, on the drivers' briefing, and we choose the places where to move."
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto predicted, "it's going to be a bit of a mess, especially as we are leaving the last corner in a push lap so quickly, and then people opening the laps are going to be so slow.

"So hopefully that's not going to be dangerous. Hopefully there is going to be something that we can do in that Turn 18 and Turn 19 corners, because I guess it can be dangerous if you are coming at I don't know 300km/h and something, and another car is at 250km/h because there is no MGU-K being deployed."
Asked if it will be discussed at the drivers' briefing on Thursday, Bortoleto said: "Yeah, but what are they going to do about it?"

One of Baku's staple challenges is the wind that flows between the buildings that surround the circuit and changes lap after lap and corner after corner. There are also 39km/h winds forecast for qualifying on Friday.
Franco Colapinto said "I think the wind is going to be tricky; last year we saw a lot of red flags because of the wind. It was changing like crazy - the gusts, because of the buildings.
"You'd get it for five seconds and the five seconds after, no gust, and then again. It was so inconsistent that it would be very difficult for us, especially on a street track.
"It makes it much more tricky and much more sketchy."
Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad wasn't so sure: "I think that's less of a thing in this year's cars because they're less sensitive with the aero". I'm sure it's still a thing, though."

detailZh: F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛：周四赛程、天气预报及观看方式
2026年一级方程式阿塞拜疆大奖赛第一次自由练习和第二次自由练习的开始时间，以及巴库完整赛程、天气预报和直播观看方式
一级方程式本周前往巴库，迎接一个时间异常提前的阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末，所有赛道上的活动都提前了一天。
自由练习于周四开始，排位赛于周五进行，大奖赛正赛将于周六举行。之所以做出调整，是因为阿塞拜疆在9月27日星期日迎来纪念日（阵亡将士纪念日）。
基米·安东内利带着对积分榜的牢牢掌控抵达巴库，他刚刚赢得了最近两场比赛的胜利。随着阿塞拜疆迎来2026赛季第15站比赛，这位梅赛德斯车手目前领先队友乔治·拉塞尔81分。
今年也是一级方程式首次在巴库街道比赛10周年。这条赛道于2016年以欧洲大奖赛的名义加入赛历，次年成为阿塞拜疆大奖赛，其狭窄的街道路段与极长的主直道相结合，应该会再次使能量释放（部署）成为比赛议程上的重点。
周四将进行第一次自由练习，随后在下午晚些时候进行第二次自由练习。以下是在阿塞拜疆大奖赛开幕日之前你需要了解的一切。
一级方程式的转播覆盖因地区而异。对于英国的观众来说，天空体育继续作为该锦标赛的独家转播商，在2026赛季全程直播每一节比赛。F1的转播也可以通过天空的流媒体平台（Sky Go）或另一流媒体平台（NOW）观看，精彩集锦则可在第四频道免费收看到。
Motorsport.com 将在整个阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末提供实时报道和更新。

detailEn: F1 Azerbaijan GP: Thursday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
What time free practice 1 and free practice 2 start at the 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix, plus the full Baku schedule, weather forecast and how to watch live
Formula 1 heads to Baku this week for an unusually early Azerbaijan GP weekend, with all of the on-track action shifted forward by a day.

Free practice begins on Thursday, qualifying takes place on Friday and the grand prix itself will be held on Saturday. The change was requested because Azerbaijan marks Remembrance Day on Sunday, September 27.

Kimi Antonelli arrives in Baku firmly in control of the championship after winning the last two races. The Mercedes driver holds an 81-point advantage over team-mate George Russell with Azerbaijan hosting round 15 of the 2026 season.

This year also marks 10 years since Formula 1 first raced on the streets of Baku. The circuit joined the calendar as the European Grand Prix in 2016 before becoming the Azerbaijan GP the following year, and its combination of tight street sections and a very long main straight should once again put energy deployment high on the agenda.
Thursday brings free practice 1 followed by free practice 2 later in the afternoon. Here is everything you need to know ahead of the opening day of the Azerbaijan GP.

Broadcast coverage of Formula 1 varies by region. For viewers in the United Kingdom, Sky Sports continues as the championship’s exclusive broadcaster, showing every session live throughout the 2026 season. F1 coverage can also be streamed via Sky Go or NOW, with highlights available free-to-air on Channel 4.
Motorsport.com will provide live coverage and updates throughout the Azerbaijan GP weekend.

Rain is unlikely, which should give teams stable conditions for the opening two practice sessions. Wind could be a bigger factor, with breezes coming in from the Caspian Sea and potentially becoming more noticeable between the buildings through Baku’s narrower sections.
Friday is expected to remain dry and sunny for final practice and qualifying, although stronger winds could make conditions more difficult.
Saturday is currently forecast to be clear for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, with temperatures around 24C at the start of the race.

前一级方程式车手乔里恩·帕尔默表示，迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在经历艰难的2026赛季后可能需要一次冬歇期重置。
皮亚斯特里在西班牙大奖赛获得第八名后，即将参加本周末的阿塞拜疆大奖赛；而他的队友兰多·诺里斯在西班牙站夺得杆位并建立起不错的领先优势，但一次时机不佳的虚拟安全车打乱了他的比赛。
在2025年争夺冠军后，皮亚斯特里在2026年表现挣扎。他目前以120分在车手积分榜上排名第七，诺里斯以186分排名第四。
在F1 Nation播客中，帕尔默评估了这位澳大利亚车手目前的状态。
“首先，奥斯卡可以庆幸迈凯伦没有以某种方式卷入冠军争夺，否则我们看待他的方式就会和看待乔治完全一样。他本赛季正在崩盘，”这位前雷诺车手解释道。
“奥斯卡去年有半个赛季看起来像冠军，他开得像冠军，表现惊人。别忘了，他是F3冠军和F2冠军。
“去年这个时候，感觉就像一位伟大的澳大利亚冠军的第二次降临。他能做到马克·韦伯没做到的事吗？感觉这是正确的。
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦
“但当你真正回顾奥斯卡在一级方程式的职业生涯时，他已经有三年半了。半年很棒。三年里，他基本上是兰多的二号车手。他有能力跑出伟大的比赛，但与兰多相比，稳定性不在，除了去年那半年，那半年时机很好，为他冲击冠军奠定了基础。”
他补充道：“奥斯卡就是这样吗？他不如兰多那样擅长让赛车滑动。去年的赛车更适合他一些，直到我们去了那些低抓地力赛道，正如安德烈亚·斯特拉所说，我们在奥斯汀和墨西哥等地更多地看到了他的局限。
“他只是一个希望状态回升的车手，但也许现在也希望明年冬天和一次重置，因为每个周末对他来说都感觉是一场真正的挣扎。”
detailEn: Jolyon Palmer suggests Oscar Piastri needs F1 reset in blunt Lando Norris comparison
Jolyon Palmer believes Oscar Piastri may need a winter reset after struggling for consistency against McLaren team-mate Lando Norris
Former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer has suggested that McLaren's Oscar Piastri may need a winter reset after a difficult 2026 campaign.

Piastri heads into this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix following an eighth-place finish at the Spanish Grand Prix, while his team-mate Lando Norris claimed pole position and built a decent lead before an ill-timed virtual safety car derailed his race.
After fighting for the championship in 2025, Piastri has struggled during 2026. He currently sits seventh in the drivers' standings with 120 points and Norris is fourth with 186 points.
Speaking on the F1 Nation podcast, Palmer assessed the Australian driver's current form.

"Number one, Oscar could be grateful that McLaren is not in the championship fight in a way because otherwise we'd be looking at him in exactly the same way as we're looking at George. He's capitulating this season," the former Renault driver explained.
"Oscar had one half of a season last year where he looked like a champion, and he drove like a champion, and he was amazing. Bearing in mind, he's an F3 champion and an F2 champion.
"It felt, this time last year, like the second coming of a great Aussie champion coming through. Could he do what Mark Webber didn't? And it felt like it was the right thing.
Lando Norris, McLaren, Oscar Piastri, McLaren

"But when you actually look through Oscar's career in Formula 1, he's had three and a half years now. Half a year was amazing. For three years, he was basically second driver to Lando. He's capable of great drives, but the consistency in comparison to Lando is not there, apart from that half-year last year, which was great timing because it set him up for a title tilt."

He added: "Is this where Oscar is at? He's not as comfortable sliding the car around as Lando. Last year's cars suited him a little bit more until we went to these low-grip tracks, as Andrea Stella was saying, and we saw his limitations a little bit more in Austin and Mexico and co.
"He's just a driver who will be hoping for a run of form, but also maybe for next winter and a bit of a reset right now because every weekend just feels like it's a real struggle for him."

items.titleZh: F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛首日：车手合约动态与2027年规则反响
items.summaryZh: 在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛首日，围场内传出车手合约动态：一份车手合约获得延长，另一份合约看起来即将结束。同时，各方对F1 2027年的两项重大选择作出了反应。
items.originalTitle: F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛首日：车手合约动态与2027年规则反响
items.summaryEn: On the first day of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the F1 paddock saw driver contract developments: one contract was extended while another appears to be ending. Meanwhile, reactions emerged to two major choices for F1 in 2027.
detailZh: 两个故事——一个已经公布，另一个正在发展中——在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前帮助填补了2027年F1车手市场中的几个空缺。
再加上车手们对最近宣布的摩纳哥冲刺赛的反应、一个意外到来的技术升级，以及梅赛德斯和法拉利的引擎罚退更新，这让F1围场里的这个周三出人意料地充满新闻。
以下是我们从这个提前开始的巴库周末到目前为止了解到的情况。
迈凯伦在巴库继续其激进的升级推进，作为将在FP1期间评估的套件的一部分，侧箱经过了大幅修改。
这发生在匈牙利和荷兰大奖赛周末期间引入的重大空气动力学升级之后，这两个周末分别位于八月休赛期两侧，同时也是修订版H翼在蒙扎首次亮相赛道，这个部件在两周前的马德里站被从车上取下后，本周末将重新出现。
侧箱经过重新塑形，向后延伸时呈现出非常不同的向下斜坡形状，这更接近法拉利和梅赛德斯的设计。此外还有一个经过修订、更垂直的进气口形状，类似于奥迪的设计。——Edd Straw
巴库的长直道意味着它是车手接受引擎更换处罚的理想地点，这就是为什么这个选项仍然在法拉利和勒克莱尔的考虑范围内。
但在梅赛德斯那边，制造商及其车手拉塞尔已决定再等一段时间，才将最后一个动力单元加入池中。
正如之前所暗示的那样，Russell 最后一次动力单元更换的时机被安排为与 梅赛德斯 即将在不久后某个时间点引入的 额外开发与升级机会步骤相吻合。10月下旬在 Austin 举行的美国大奖赛将是一个合乎逻辑的举办地点。
从 Russell 的角度来看，现在接受发车位罚退，然后在几场比赛之后当更好的部件到来时又面临另一次罚退，是毫无意义的。
有人猜测 梅赛德斯 的 ADUO 升级将围绕涡轮增压器展开，而 Russell 本人在 Baku 几乎证实了这一点，当时他说他不得不等待，因为在排位赛中发生故障后，他不得不在 Hungary 额外使用了一个涡轮增压器。
“这有点复杂，”他说。“但长话短说，如果我现在拿了一个，我就不得不再拿一个。”—— Jon Noble
...而 Hamilton 的引擎可能已经“赢得了一场比赛”
我们正处于赛季的这个阶段：大多数 F1 车队都在拼命计算，他们的车手在动力单元上剩余的里程是否足以坚持到赛季结束，而无需接受发车位罚退。
对于一些人（例如 Russell）来说，这种命运不可避免，因此关键在于选择最佳时机来执行。
汉密尔顿 在最近几周也处于类似境地，因为看起来如果不进行更换，他将无法坚持到本赛季结束。
但在阿塞拜疆大奖赛之前，汉密尔顿透露，他在西班牙大奖赛早早退赛的阴云中还有一线希望。这次退赛减少了他最新动力单元上的里程数，足以让他现在有可能用现有的装备撑到赛季结束。
“我‘多赚’了一场比赛，所以我认为应该没问题，”他在巴库说道。
然而，他表示，如果法拉利得出结论认为新引擎带来的额外性能超过了任何发车位处罚的负面影响，那么可能会采取战术性决定。
“自然，对于引擎来说，从全新到完成几场比赛后，性能上会有差异，所以我们会在今年晚些时候做出那个决定，”他说。
队友勒克莱尔也是迟早需要一台新引擎的人之一。他正在权衡何时接受罚退最为合适，而他在本周末的巴库就选择这么做也并非不可能。
不过对他来说一个好消息是，他那台最新ADUO 2规格的蒙扎引擎现在已经回到他的引擎池中，可以随时使用。—— JN
据The 比赛的Scott Mitchell-Malm报道，埃斯特班·奥康预计将在年底被哈斯车队放弃，不会获得续约合同——这让他在继续自己已近200场大奖赛的F1生涯方面选择有限。
虽然奥康目前占据的席位尚未正式确定人选，但The 比赛了解到，法拉利F2争冠青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉处于领先位置——而且奥康看起来甚至连第二选择都不是。
奥康在周三的发言确实像一位知道自己与当前车队没有共同未来的车手，他称自己为“自由身”，并反复回避关于在哈斯继续任职的问题。
而且他显然感到委屈，因为哈斯在两辆赛车于每个比赛周产生一致、相等负载方面的问题有据可查。
“今年我的表现不是问题。每次我拿到有竞争力的赛车时，我都发挥出来了，”他说。——瓦伦丁·霍鲁恩日伊
红牛的新秀无法对哈贾尔的交易提出异议
近年来，在红牛二队中，像Arvid Lindblad这样健康的新秀赛季通常意味着立即晋升到主队——这在很大程度上是因为维斯塔潘一直在摧毁任何与他搭档的队友。
但Lindblad最早也要等到2028年才能获得晋升。尽管他认为哈贾尔在主队的续约“比正常情况稍早了一些”，但他表示自己无法质疑这一决定。
“完全归功于Isack，他可能是过去八年中第一位在红牛作为第二车手表现出色的车手——所以也祝贺他，他获得了提前宣布的安心感，”Lindblad承认道。
“对我自己来说，这并不是我真正考虑的事情；我非常专注于自己，我知道自己正在走的道路和轨迹。我对自己目前的位置非常满意。”
小红牛 队友 劳森 表示，接替 Hadjar 席位的可能性对他来说也从未真正成为一个话题——即使在他最近几场比赛中令人印象深刻地替补出战 红牛 之后也是如此——而且 Hadjar 的新合同“并不令人意外”。- VK
威廉姆斯全年直到现在都超重。至关重要的是，阿尔本 已确认，由于引入两个全新底盘，赛车不仅达到了 768 公斤的最低重量限制，实际上还低于这一标准。
这使威廉姆斯能够携带压舱物，这对于微调重量分配很有用。
“今年到目前为止，我们一直承受着相当大的重量惩罚，”Albon 说。“进入这个周末，我们在车上装了压舱物，所以你可以想象，在很多方面都会有巨大的[性能]提升。重量本身是件大事，而重量是圈速的保证，所以这就是为什么我们知道，无论空气动力学方面表现如何，这都会是很好的一步——但这是一次很好的升级。”
赛季开始时，威廉姆斯FW48被认为超重约28公斤。虽然在随后的比赛中这一重量被逐渐削减，但需要新底盘来实现大部分的减重。
这一点，加上空气动力学升级，预计将给威廉姆斯带来显著的性能提升。本赛季威廉姆斯平均是第九快的赛车，但最近已滑落至第十，落后于有所改进的阿斯顿·马丁-本田。
然而，正如阿尔本所指出的，这是一次“在任何其他年份都会是巨大”的升级，但鉴于整个围场的整体发展速度，它相对而言并不像通常那样是一次巨大的跨越。
尽管如此，他表示“这肯定能让我们重新回到与那个集团竞争的行列”——即使队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯给出了悲观的评价：“即使有所有这些升级，我们仍然会难以冲出Q1，也难以跻身Q2前列。”
detailEn: Two stories - one that's been announced, and another that's developing - have helped fill in a couple more gaps in the 2027 Formula 1 driver market ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Throw in drivers' reactions to the recently announced Monaco sprint race, the arrival of an unexpected tech upgrade, and engine-penalty updates at Mercedes and Ferrari, and it's been a surprisingly newsworthy Wednesday in the F1 paddock.
Here's what we've learned so far from this early-starting Baku weekend.
McLaren is continuing its aggressive upgrade push in Baku, with dramatically revised sidepods as part of the package it will evaluate during FP1.

This follows the major aerodynamic upgrade introduced across the Hungarian and Dutch GP weekends either side of the August break and the first on-track appearance of the revised H-wing at Monza, a part that will reappear this weekend having been taken off the car for the Madring two weeks ago.

The sidepods have been reshaped to have a very different downward ramp shape as they travel rearwards, which is closer to the Ferrari and Mercedes designs. There's also a revised, more vertical inlet shape similar to the Audi design. - Edd Straw
Baku's long straights mean it is an attractive place for drivers to take engine change penalties, which is why that option remains on the radar for Ferrari and Charles Leclerc.
But over at Mercedes, the manufacturer and its driver George Russell have committed to waiting a bit longer to add the final power unit to the pool.

As has been hinted at before, the timing of Russell's final power unit change is planned to coincide with an ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) step that Mercedes will introduce at some point soon. The United States GP at Austin in late-October would be a logical place for it.
From Russell's perspective, there is no point taking a grid drop now only to then face another one a few races down the road when the better parts come along.

There has been speculation that the Mercedes ADUO upgrade will revolve around the turbo, something that Russell himself all but confirmed in Baku when he said he was having to wait because he had to take an extra one in Hungary after a failure in qualifying.
"It's all a bit complicated," he said. "But long story short, if I took one now, I would have had to have taken another one." - Jon Noble
...and Hamilton's engine might've 'gained a race'

We are at that stage of the season where most F1 teams are furiously trying to work out if their drivers have enough miles left in their power units to get to the end without the need for a grid drop penalty.
For some (such as Russell) that fate is unavoidable, so it is a matter of picking the best time to do it.
Lewis Hamilton had been in a similar situation over recent weeks as it looked like he would not make it through to the end of the campaign without a swap.

But ahead of the Azerbaijan GP, Hamilton revealed that there was a silver lining to the cloud of his early Spanish GP retirement. The DNF reduced the mileage on his latest power unit enough to make it possible to now get through to the end of the campaign with what he has.
"I 'gained' a race, so I think it should be OK," he said in Baku.
However, he has suggested that a tactical call could come into play if Ferrari concludes that the extra performance a fresh engine gives outweighs the downside of any grid drop.
"Naturally with engines, from new to when they've done several races, there is a difference in performance, so we will take that decision later on in the year," he said.
Team-mate Leclerc is one of those who will need a fresh one at some point. He is weighing up when best to take a penalty, and it's not impossible he elects to do so in Baku this weekend.
One good bit of news for him, though, is that his Monza engine, of the latest ADUO 2 spec, is now back in his pool and available to be used. - JN

As reported by The Race's Scott Mitchell-Malm, Esteban Ocon is now expected to be let go by Haas at the end of the year without a renewal offer - leaving him with limited options to continue an F1 career that has already spanned nearly 200 starts.

While the seat Ocon currently occupies has not been filled officially, The Race understands Ferrari's Formula 2 title-contending junior Rafael Camara is in pole position - and it doesn't appear like Ocon is even second choice.

Ocon certainly spoke on Wednesday like a driver who knows there is no joint future with his current team, describing himself as a "free agent" and repeatedly deflecting questions about a continued employment at Haas.
And he clearly feels hard done by, given Haas's well-documented issues in the matter of its two cars producing consistent, equal load weekend to weekend.
"My performance hasn't been an issue this year. I've performed every time I had the [performing] car," he said. - Valentin Khorounzhiy
Red Bull's rookie can't argue with Hadjar deal

In recent years, a rookie season as healthy as the one Arvid Lindblad has enjoyed in Red Bull's second team has usually meant an immediate graduation to the main team - in large part because Max Verstappen has been demolishing anyone matching up against him as a team-mate.

But Lindblad will have to wait until 2028 at the earliest to get a promotion. And while he reckons Isack Hadjar's extension at the main team came "a little bit earlier than normal", he says he can't question the decision.

"Full credit to Isack, he's probably been one of the first drivers in the last eight years that has been performing well as the second driver in Red Bull - so also fair play to him that he gets that comfort of getting announced a bit earlier," Lindblad acknowledged.
"For myself, it wasn't really something I was thinking about; I'm very focused on myself, I know my own path and trajectory that I'm on. I'm very happy where I am at the moment."

Racing Bulls team-mate Liam Lawson indicated that the prospect of taking Hadjar's seat was also never really a topic for him - even after his impressive stand-in stint at Red Bull in recent races - and that the new Hadjar deal is "not surprising". - VK

Williams has been overweight all year, up to now. Crucially, Alex Albon has confirmed that not only is the car on the minimum weight limit of 768kg thanks to the introduction of two brand-new chassis, but it is in reality below that.
This allows Williams to carry ballast, which is useful for fine-tuning the weight distribution.

"We've been carrying a substantial weight penalty this year so far," said Albon. "Going into this weekend, we've got ballast on the car, so you could imagine there's a big [performance] swing in many ways. The weight itself is a big thing and weight is a guarantee of laptime, so that's why we know it will be a good step regardless of how the aero side performs - but it's a good upgrade."

At the start of the season, the Williams FW48 was understood to be around 28kg over the weight limit. While that was whittled away at in the ensuing races, it required the new chassis to achieve the majority of the weight reduction.

That, combined with the aerodynamic upgrades, is expected to give a significant performance bump to the Williams, which has been the ninth-fastest car on average this season but lately slipped to 10th behind the improved Aston Martin-Honda.

However, as Albon has pointed out, this is an upgrade that "in any other year would have been a massive one" but that isn't as big a relative stride as it normally would be given the overall rate of development across the grid.

Nonetheless, he says "it's certainly going to get us back in contention with that group" - even if team-mate Carlos Sainz offered the downbeat verdict that "even with all the upgrades, we're still going to struggle to get out of Q1 and we're going to struggle to be at the top end of Q2".

items.summaryZh: 前F1车手大卫·库特哈德表示，乔治·拉塞尔正被迫“重塑自己的思维”，因为他难以持续与梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利匹敌。拉塞尔在赛季前被视为2026年冠军热门之一，但在赢得澳大利亚大奖赛和中国冲刺赛后，他只能眼看着年轻的队友取得成绩。

Russell was considered one of the favourites for the 2026 title heading into the season, but after winning the Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race, he watched on as his teenage team-mate took the lead of the standings.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在基米·安东内利的困境中被迫“重塑大脑”，大卫·库特哈德如是说
大卫·库特哈德评估基米·安东内利与乔治·拉塞尔之间的梅赛德斯队内竞争
前一级方程式车手大卫·库特哈德表示，乔治·拉塞尔正被迫“重塑自己的大脑”，因为他难以持续与梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利匹敌。
拉塞尔在赛季前被视为2026年冠军的热门人选之一，但在赢得澳大利亚大奖赛和中国冲刺赛后，他只能眼看着年轻的队友取得积分榜领先。
在西班牙大奖赛上赢得本赛季第八场胜利后，安东内利在积分榜上领先拉塞尔81分。
在《Up To Speed》播客的一期节目中，库特哈德将拉塞尔目前的困境与他早年搭档米卡·哈基宁在迈凯伦的经历相提并论。
“乔治肯定正在经历一种第一次的体验，就像我当年第一次经历的那样，那时米卡和我是队友，因为当我在94年加入F1时，我立刻就展现出了速度，”库特哈德解释道。
“实际上，在95年，有五场大奖赛我连续获得杆位。
“所以当我回顾时，我只是在想，‘这很正常。’你想想达蒙·希尔（他当时的队友），他年纪更大，已经在那里了，他经历过与艾尔顿（塞纳）做队友以及他的致命事故，他一定很讨厌这种情况。
“他一定在抓狂，当时我们相处得并不好，因为我是他的眼中钉，就像基米一样，年轻气盛地进来，出去就拿到杆位，而且并不真的多想。
“然后我意识到，一旦你进入职业生涯，当你获得更多经验时，有时你会过度思考情况。所以基米现在只是天真烂漫、充满活力。
“他不知道他不知道什么。乔治则在想，‘等等。我一直很快。为什么这没有发生？’所以他不得不在下一个周末到来时重塑自己的大脑，而他又被击败了。”
detailEn: George Russell forced to "rewire his brain" amid Kimi Antonelli struggles, says David Coulthard
David Coulthard assesses the Mercedes intra-team battle between Kimi Antonelli and George Russell
George Russell is being forced to "rewire his brain" as he struggles to consistently match his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli, according to former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard.

Russell was considered one of the favourites for the 2026 title heading into the season, but after winning the Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race, he watched on as his teenage team-mate took the lead of the standings.
After claiming his eighth win of the season at the Spanish Grand Prix, Antonelli holds an 81-point lead over Russell in the standings.
During an episode of the Up To Speed podcast, Coulthard drew parallels between Russell's current woes and his own early days partnering Mika Hakkinen at McLaren.

"George is definitely going through an experience for the first time like I went through for the first time when Mika and I were team-mates, because when I joined Formula 1 in '94, straight away I was on the pace," Coulthard explained.
"Actually, for '95 there was a run of five grands prix where I was in pole position for each of those grands prix.

"So when I look at it, I was just thinking, 'This is normal.' You think for Damon Hill [his team-mate at the time], who was older and he'd been there, and he'd lived through being the team-mate with Ayrton [Senna] and his fatality, he must have hated it.

"He must have been pulling his hair out, and we didn't really get along at that time because I was the thorn in his side who just came in like Kimi, all young and went out and got pole position and not really think about it.
"And then what I realised once you get into your career and when you get more experience as well, sometimes you're overthinking situations. So Kimi is just bright-eyed and bushy-tailed right now.

"He doesn't know what he doesn't know. George is going, 'Hold on. I've always been quick. Why is this not happening?' So he's having to rewire his brain while the next weekend comes and he gets beaten again."

detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘对F1摩纳哥大奖赛冲刺赛的直率反应：“毫无情感可言”
2027年计划在摩纳哥举办冲刺赛，引发了F1车手们的不同反应，但马克斯·维斯塔潘表示他不在乎冲刺赛在哪里举行。他尽职尽责地参加，却没有任何情感。
2027年公布的F1赛历在大奖赛顺序上看起来合乎逻辑，但部分冲刺赛举办地的选择令人意外。
F1不仅决定将冲刺赛数量增加到10场——这在商业上不可避免——所选地点也颇为耐人寻味。例如，巴林揭幕战和阿布扎比收官战都被指定为冲刺赛周末。
这本身就有些引人注目，而选择摩纳哥作为冲刺赛举办地更是在围场中引发了更大的意外。
塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在巴库媒体日表示，他没想到会这样，只是通过其他车手的直言反应才得知这一消息。
“其实我是通过我们的[WhatsApp]群聊知道的。里面有一些评论，”这位凯迪拉克车手笑着说。
“群里有点热闹！除了群里发生的事，我没太注意。而且如你所想，那些内容就留在群里了。”
佩雷斯透露，摩纳哥冲刺赛是F1车手WhatsApp群里的热门讨论话题。
在公开表态中，车手们对摩纳哥冲刺赛的反应各不相同。是的，这场短程比赛将是一场巡游，但这一选择确实让蒙特卡洛街道两次迎来排位赛的刺激。
尽管这听起来很吸引人，但它对车手如何构建比赛周末有重大影响。在赛道边行走时，很容易看到车手通常在一练中留有余地，并在三练中于Tabac和Piscine等弯角越来越接近护栏。
随着冲刺赛制，这种逐步推向周六下午终极高潮的过程消失了，同时车手在冲刺排位赛中愿意承担多少风险也非常值得怀疑。例如，如果你必须从SQ1中杀出重围，排在第12或第13位，回报是什么？由于超车几乎不可能，第13位发车通常不会带来积分，这使得对大多数车手来说，周五不撞车更为重要。
“也许你会少冒一点风险，”小红牛车手阿维德·林德布拉德承认。“如果你排在第15位，也许你不会那么努力，但顶级车队总是必须全力推进。”
“我认为这只会意味着你无法像希望的那样为排位赛做好铺垫。你只是必须在周末更早地离开舒适区。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘不屑于这样的分析。他的反应简短而明确：这位四届世界冠军不喜欢冲刺赛周末，而且永远不会喜欢，无论它们在哪里举行。
维斯塔潘表示，无论场地如何，他对冲刺赛毫无情感。
“是的，更多冲刺赛……我个人不喜欢，但我当然理解背后的理由，”维斯塔潘在巴库说。
“它让整个周末有更多动作，所以，是的，我们会参加……但对我来说，我始终想着大奖赛，那才是我主要的关注点。”
最重要的是，维斯塔潘认为冲刺赛会提前剧透车迷将在周日看到的内容，而在摩纳哥这一点更加可预测：两场比赛都没有太多超车。
“关于摩纳哥的冲刺赛，是的，情况和正赛一样，对吧？”维斯塔潘说。“比如，你对起步感到兴奋，然后你无法超车。这很直接。”
当被问及维斯塔潘是否对选择摩纳哥感到意外时，这位荷兰人强调他不在乎冲刺赛的地点，他只是因为这是工作的一部分而参加。
“我不知道。对我来说，老实说我不在乎冲刺赛在哪里，”他说。“我只是参加，当然你会尽力做到最好。但我对赢得冲刺赛或没赢都没有情感。”
“从我小时候起，你期待的是大奖赛。那通常是在周日，有时是周六，”他指的是今年巴库比赛在周六举行。
自2023年以来，F1没有选择巴库举办冲刺赛。
与此同时，林德布拉德补充说，巴库城市赛道非常适合举办冲刺赛。这是一条排位赛充满娱乐性的街道赛道，也是一个可以超车的地方。
“这应该是一场冲刺赛，这会是一场精彩的冲刺赛，”这位小红牛车手说。“最终，这是一条我们可以超车的赛道，而冲刺赛的全部意义就是全力冲刺和超车。我认为这应该办一场。”
巴库在2026年和2027年都不是冲刺赛周末。
detailEn: Max Verstappen's blunt reaction to F1's Monaco GP sprint race: "No emotion attached to it"

The planned sprint race in Monaco for 2027 has prompted mixed reactions from F1 drivers, but Max Verstappen says he does not care where the sprints are held. He dutifully takes part in them, without feeling any emotion
The Formula 1 calendar presented for 2027 looks logical when it comes to the sequence of grands prix, but some of the choices for the sprint races have caused surprise.

F1 has not only decided to increase the number to 10 – which was commercially inevitable – but the chosen locations are interesting as well. The opening weekend in Bahrain and the season finale in Abu Dhabi, for example, have both been designated as sprint weekends.
That is somewhat remarkable in itself, although the choice of Monaco as a sprint venue caused even more surprise in the paddock.
Sergio Perez said during media day in Baku that he did not see that one coming and only learned the news through the outspoken reactions of other drivers.
"I found out through our [WhatsApp] group, actually. There were some comments there," the Cadillac driver smiled.
"It was a bit busy in the group! I didn’t pay much attention, other than what happened in the group. And that stays in the group, as you can imagine."
Perez revealed that the Monaco sprint was a hot topic of discussion in the F1 drivers’ WhatsApp group

On the record, drivers have responded differently to the sprint race in Monaco. Yes, the short race will be a procession, but this choice does bring the excitement of qualifying to the streets of Monte Carlo twice.

Although that sounds appealing, it has significant consequences for how drivers build up their race weekend. When walking trackside, it is easy to see how drivers normally leave some margin during FP1 and get increasingly closer to the barriers in corners such as Tabac and Piscine during final practice.

That build-up towards an ultimate climax on Saturday afternoon disappears with the sprint format, while it is also very much open to question how much risk drivers want to take in sprint qualifying. For example, If you have to fight your way out of SQ1 for 12th or 13th on the grid, what is the reward? With overtaking virtually impossible, that 13th starting position will normally not lead to points, making it more important for most drivers not to crash on Friday.
"Maybe you take a bit less risk," Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad admitted. "If you're P15, maybe you don't try as hard, but the top teams, they'd always have to push.
"I think it would just mean that you can't build as nicely as you'd want towards qualifying. You just have to get outside your comfort zone a bit earlier in the weekend."
Max Verstappen does not bother with such analyses. His reaction is short but clear: the four-time world champion is not a fan of sprint weekends and never will be, regardless of where they are held.
Verstappen says he feels no emotion whatsoever about sprint races, regardless of the venue
"Yeah, more sprint races… Personally, I’m not a fan of it, but I understand the reasoning behind it, of course," Verstappen said in Baku.
"It brings more action throughout the weekend, so yeah, we'll participate... But, for me, I always think about the grand prix and that's where my main focus is."
Above all, Verstappen considers a sprint race a spoiler for what fans will see on Sunday, something that is even more predictable in Monaco: two races without much overtaking.

"About the sprint in Monaco, yeah, it's the same scenario as what happens in the main race, right?" Verstappen said. "Like, you are excited for the start and then you can't pass. That's quite straightforward."

Asked whether Verstappen is surprised by the choice of Monaco, the Dutchman stresses that he does not care about the locations of the sprints and that he simply takes part because that is part of his job.

"I don't know. For me, I honestly don't care where the sprint races are," he said. "I just participate and of course you try to do the best you can. But I have no emotion attached to winning a sprint race or not winning it.
"From when I was a kid, you look forward to the grand prix. That's normally on a Sunday or sometimes on a Saturday," referring to the Baku race being held on Saturday this year.
F1 hasn't opted for Baku to host a sprint race since 2023
Lindblad, meanwhile, added that the Baku City Circuit would be perfect for a sprint race. It is a street circuit where qualifying is entertaining and a place where overtaking is possible.

"This should be a sprint, this would be an amazing sprint race”, the Racing Bulls driver said. "In the end, it's a track we can pass and the whole point of a sprint race is the idea of a flat-out race and passing. I think this should be one."
Baku is not a sprint weekend in either 2026 or 2027.

Lewis Hamilton and George Russell disagree on the Monaco Grand Prix becoming a Sprint weekend in 2027.

Last week, Formula 1 announced its 2027 calendar and revealed there will be an increase in the number of Sprint events from six to 10, with Monaco holding the alternative format that sees an extra qualifying session on Friday before a 100km Sprint on Saturday.

Monaco is one of the most difficult tracks to overtake at, but F1 highlighted the prospect of two qualifying sessions as an additional chance for "the drivers to show their world-class skill and precision on the narrow streets of Monte Carlo".

But I think we've got to come up with something new for somewhere like that because it's a beautiful place, such a beautiful country, an incredible circuit to drive, but the race is as dull as it gets. detailZh: James Hinchcliffe解释为何法拉利对刘易斯·汉密尔顿与查尔斯·勒克莱尔的竞争感到"满意"
James Hinchcliffe认为法拉利乐于处理刘易斯·汉密尔顿与查尔斯·勒克莱尔之间不断升级的竞争
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
前IndyCar系列赛车手、F1 TV评论员James Hinchcliffe认为，法拉利"乐于"处理刘易斯·汉密尔顿与查尔斯·勒克莱尔之间不断升级的队内竞争，并坚称这正是马拉内罗车队签下这位七届世界冠军时所期望的。
在2025年加盟法拉利的首个赛季表现挣扎后，汉密尔顿在2026年实现反弹，适应了车队并融入了新规则。他在中国大奖赛为弗雷德·瓦塞尔领导的车队首次登上大奖赛领奖台，并在巴塞罗那-加泰罗尼亚大奖赛取得首胜。
这位英国人目前以191分位列车手积分榜第三，落后榜首基米·安东内利101分。勒克莱尔以167分排名第五。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前做客F1 Nation播客时，Hinchcliffe被问及汉密尔顿的复苏是否给法拉利车队负责人瓦塞尔带来了意想不到的难题。
"我认为他们乐于拥有这个问题，"他说。"我不认为法拉利会签下一个他们预期会比查尔斯——'法拉利金童'——更慢、更顺从的车手。"
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
"所有人都清楚刘易斯的能力，弗雷德从一开始就看到了。所以，不，我认为他们去年对两人之间缺乏问题感到更意外，因为刘易斯当时的速度不如查尔斯，而今年才真正是他们所期待的局面，坦率地说，这也是他们想要的。"
"当你有两位能这样互相推动的车手时，你会帮助车队变得更好。是的，某个时刻可能会引发一些艰难的对话和艰难的决定，但那是身处特权位置才会有的烦恼。"
"这是他们希望的局面，如果明年赛车调校得当，我们明年可能会进行类似的对话，但谈论的将是他们应该支持谁争夺冠军的影响。"
detailEn: James Hinchcliffe explains why Ferrari is "happy" with Lewis Hamilton-Charles Leclerc rivalry
James Hinchcliffe believes Ferrari is happy to manage the growing rivalry between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

Former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe has argued that Ferrari is "happy" to manage the escalating intra-team rivalry between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc, insisting it is exactly what the Maranello outfit wanted when it signed the seven-time champion.

After struggling in his first season with Ferrari in 2025, Hamilton bounced back in 2026, having adjusted to the team and gelled with the new set of regulations. He secured his first grand prix podium with the Fred Vasseur-led team at the Chinese Grand Prix and his first win at the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix.
The Briton currently sits third in the drivers' standings with 191 points, 101 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli. Leclerc is fifth with 167 points.
During an appearance on the F1 Nation podcast ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, Hinchcliffe was asked if Hamilton's resurgence had created an unforeseen headache for Ferrari team chief Vasseur.
"I think they're happy to have the problem," he said. "I don't think Ferrari would sign somebody that they were anticipating to be slower and subservient to Charles, to the 'Ferrari Golden Boy'.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

"Everybody knows exactly what Lewis is capable of, and Fred has seen it from the beginning. So, no, I think they were more surprised last year at the lack of issue they had with this because Lewis wasn't up to the same pace as Charles, and that this year is really more what they were expecting to have, and frankly, it's what they want.

"When you have two drivers that can push each other like this, you're going to help make the team better. Yes, at some point it might bring up some difficult conversations and some difficult decisions, but that's a privileged position to be in.
"It's one that they hope, if they get the car right next year, that we'll be having similar conversations next year, but talking about the championship implications of who they should back."

items.originalTitle: 诺里斯驾驶迈凯伦Hypercar测试，称有助于提升F1表现
items.summaryEn: Reigning world champion Lando Norris drove McLaren's new Hypercar, the MCL-HY, at Algarve last week, completing 38 laps and providing feedback to the team ahead of its 2027 debut. He believes the test can help improve his Formula 1 performances.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯如何通过一次超级跑车（Hypercar）测试在F1中变得更强
兰多·诺里斯上周驾驶了迈凯伦全新的世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）赛车；勒芒虽然还是遥远地平线上的目标，但他已经从中获得了一些立竿见影的好处
兰多·诺里斯驾驶迈凯伦全新超级跑车（Hypercar），在F1的大局中看似无关紧要，但这位卫冕世界冠军不会同意这种说法。
诺里斯上周在阿尔加维赛道驾驶了MCL-HY赛车，仅完成了38圈——这足以让他体验世界耐力锦标赛顶级赛车的性能，并在迈凯伦品牌于2027年首次参赛之前为其提供反馈。
这位26岁的车手在测试结束后接受Motorsport.com采访时表示，相对于一级方程式，这款车调校选项的深度令他印象深刻，并坚称它“仍然是一辆很快的车”。
“他们钻研的细节程度相当疯狂，”诺里斯说。“在某些情况下，他们在赛车上的发挥空间比我们在一级方程式中被允许的要大得多。”
“尽管你以为一级方程式就是‘想做什么就做什么’，但实际并非完全如此。在如何更换装备和调校赛车本身方面，其实在电子系统等各个方面，比超级跑车（Hypercar）所能做的要受限得多。”
“所以能看到你能做些什么还是挺酷的。这有点像老派的一级方程式，那时候更像是各显神通、想怎么做就怎么做，这是件好事。”
“当然，这是一辆非常不同的车，相当重，所以需要去适应它；显然下压力少了不少，但它仍然感觉很快，所以还是很刺激。”
作为参考，标致车队的马尔勒·雅各布森在今年的斯帕-弗朗科尔尚六小时赛中以2分00.653秒夺得杆位，而F1的2026年基准是安东内利创造的1分44.361秒，拉斐尔·卡马拉则以1分56.306秒在F2排位赛中名列第一。
诺里斯在这条葡萄牙赛道上与迈凯伦的两位2027年车手米克尔·延森和洛朗斯·范托尔一同测试，这为这位英国车手提供了更多的学习机会。
“这次更多是让我尝试一些东西，同时也是去学习，”他说。“我所做的一切，真的，即使我驾驶其他车，也总是试图去学习东西——理解不同的风格，向我在那边遇到的其他车手学习，看看我能吸收些什么来帮助我这个周末跑得更好。”
“所以这总是一个很好的机会，尤其是能留在迈凯伦大家庭里。这有助于我学习，并让我在做我真正的工作——一级方程式——时更加专注。”
当2027年勒芒24小时耐力赛被提起时，诺里斯对最后这一点态度非常坚决，因为明年这项赛事与一级方程式并不冲突——只有测试日（Test 当天）有冲突。
“这根本不是我一直在考虑的事情，”他坚持说，“我所有的注意力仍然放在一级方程式上，而且永远都会如此。我绝不会为了别的事情牺牲一级方程式中的任何东西。”
“如果有机会让事情顺利安排下来，也许吧，但我不知道这是在明年、后年、三年还是四年之后——我完全不知道。再说一遍，这根本不是我一直考虑的事情，但这是我将来想要去做的事情。”
detailEn: How Lando Norris gets better at F1 with a Hypercar test
Lando Norris was on track with McLaren’s new WEC challenger last week; Le Mans is a remote prospect on the horizon, but he still found some immediate advantages
Lando Norris driving McLaren’s new Hypercar may seem inconsequential in the grand scheme of Formula 1 things, but the reigning world champion would disagree.

Norris took the wheel of the MCL-HY at Algarve last week, completing just 38 laps – enough to get a feel for the World Endurance Championship’s top machinery and provide feedback to McLaren ahead of the brand’s 2027 debut.
The 26-year-old was impressed with the depth of set-up options relative to Formula 1 and insisted it was ‘still a quick car’ when asked by Motorsport.com about his thoughts following the test.
“The level of detail that they go into is pretty crazy,” Norris said. “They have, in some situations, a lot more scope to do things with the car than what we're allowed to do in Formula 1.

“As much as you think Formula 1 is ‘you can do whatever you want’, it's not quite that. With how you can change the toys and set up the car itself, it’s actually quite a bit more limited than you can do with the Hypercar in terms of electronics and all of these things.
“So it's pretty cool to see what you could do. It's a bit more like old-school Formula 1, when it was a bit more just a free-for-all on what you could do, which is a good thing.
“Of course, it's a very different car, it's quite a heavy car, so adapting to that; obviously quite a bit less downforce, but it still feels like a quick car, so it's still exciting.”

As a reference, Peugeot’s Malthe Jakobsen took pole position in 2m00.653s at this year’s Spa-Francorchamps 6 Hours, where F1’s 2026 benchmark was Kimi Antonelli’s 1m44.361s while Rafael Camara topped F2 qualifying in 1m56.306s.
Norris was joined at the Portuguese track by two of McLaren’s 2027 drivers, Mikkel Jensen and Laurens Vanthoor, which provided the Briton with further learning opportunities.

“It was more, again, for me to try something and also to learn things,” he said. “Everything I do, really, even when I drive other cars, is always to try and learn things – understand different styles, learn from the other drivers that I met over there, and see what I can take onboard to help me drive better this weekend.
“So it's always a good opportunity, especially to stay within the McLaren family. It helps me learn and be more focused for doing my real job, which is Formula 1.”
Norris was adamant about that last part when the 2027 Le Mans 24 Hours was brought up, given the race doesn’t clash with F1 next year – only the Test Day does.
“It's not something I've been thinking about, at all,” he insisted. “All my focus is still on F1, and will always be. I'll never sacrifice something in Formula 1 for something else.

“If there's a chance that things can work out, maybe, but I don't know if this is next year, the year after, three years, four years – I have no idea. Again, it's not something I've been thinking about at all, but it's something I would like to do in the future.”
